intro.title: Pasta & tradition
intro.body: At CARBO, discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of Carcassonne. Fresh homemade pasta, traditional recipes and seasonal produce — a generous and warm experience in our Italian restaurant at 11 rue Trivalle.

about.loulousBody: We are Louis and Louisa, a young couple passionate about food and hospitality. Our adventure begins with a simple idea: to create a warm place to share authentic Italian dishes, refined cocktails and, above all, convivial moments.
about.chefBody: Behind the stove, Louisa, a lover of Italian cuisine, prepares homemade dishes inspired by traditional recipes and seasonal produce.
about.barmanBody: In the dining room, Louis welcomes you with a smile, advises you on the wines and crafts carefully designed cocktails to accompany your meals.
about.carboBody: And of course, there is Carbo, our little dachshund and the restaurant's mascot, who joins us on this wonderful adventure.
